summary.zh-CN: 比较口径一致的数据，识别缺失基线，只建议一个有证据的下一步。
summary.en: Compare compatible observations, preserve missing baselines and choose one evidence-backed next step.

inputs.zh-CN: 数据导出、改动记录、可比基线、观察窗口
inputs.en: Data export, change log, comparable baseline and observation window

outputs.zh-CN: 迭代决策卡；复查与停止条件
outputs.en: Decision card, review conditions and stopping rules

safety.zh-CN: 默认只读与本地产物；不自动修改生产、提交索引或外发。
safety.en: Read-only analysis and local artifacts by default; no automatic production changes, indexing submission or outreach.

prompt.zh-CN: 请使用 $seo-measure-decide，仅分析我提供或已授权读取的资料。先检查必要输入，未知数据保留未知，按 Skill 模板交付并列出验收结果；不要自动发布。
prompt.en: Use $seo-measure-decide to analyze only supplied or authorized materials. Check required inputs, preserve unknowns, deliver the skill template and acceptance results, and do not publish automatically.
